question: Identify the ID and age of male patients diagnosed with SJS who have had at least two laboratory tests showing elevated hematocrit levels (HCT ≥ 45), and whose albumin levels have always remained within the normal range (3.5 < ALB < 5.5).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  p."XCL_058" AS ID,
  CAST(julianday('now') - julianday(p."XCL_060") AS INTEGER) / 365 AS age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND p."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
  AND p."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT l."XCL_014"
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_033" >= 45
    GROUP BY l."XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT(l."XCL_014") >= 2
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_014" = p."XCL_058"
      AND l."XCL_031" IS NOT NULL
      AND (l."XCL_031" <= 3.5 OR l."XCL_031" >= 5.5)
  );

  AND p."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
  AND p."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT l."XCL_014"
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_033" >= 45
    GROUP BY l."XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT(l."XCL_014") >= 2
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_014" = p."XCL_058"
      AND l."XCL_031" IS NOT NULL
      AND (l."XCL_031" <= 3.5 OR l."XCL_031" >= 5.5)
  );
